test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to he at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All cats are tigers.

All tigers are lions,

Some tigers are dogs.

**Conclusions:**

I. All cats are lions.

II. Some dogs are lions.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow
